source: Words from the idea only: working_name, product_type, concept, audience, season, themes and format. Central theme = the season named in the working name; the other listed themes and concept motifs are tangential. The idea does not say printable or digital, so those words are not included.
notes: Seasonality was not supplied, so it is null (scored as neutral 50 and flagged); it is never inferred from the date.
